**The 3D views say why they show no textures**

Up close at High, the 3D views could turn into flat colours, a square a block, with nothing to say why: Massif had not found Minecraft to read its textures from, or the graphics card could not draw them. Massif now also looks for the game where Prism and the Modrinth App keep it on Windows, macOS and Linux; when it still finds none, or the graphics card fails, the views keep their flat colours and Settings ▸ Graphics says why under Game textures in the 3D views, as does startup.log.
